01_imported: Batch imported and analyzed; capability badges and job counts at the top.
02_text_search_highlight: text:"feature store" finds an image named IMG_0001_q9z.png and highlights the OCR region.
03_source_and_text: Visible-LinkedIn-UI source filter AND a literal OCR phrase, with evidence and typed decisions.
04_object_filter: object:cat — the detector box that matched is drawn; score is a raw detector score.
05_find_similar: Find similar from the inspected image (visual similarity, no fabricated boxes).
06_linkedin_collection: Smart set 'LinkedIn screenshots' with membership method, affinity and its kind.
07_correction: Rename + exclude a member; recorded as corrections, kept across re-analysis.
08_video_text_at_time: A video's on-screen text: found at 0:04 and highlighted on that keyframe (MediaMetadata/1.2).
09_generate_from_library: Generate clips straight from the library video; the status says ASR is unavailable. (The test Chromium build has no H.264 decoder, hence 'not playable'; the clip is valid and downloadable.)
10_after_restart_export: After an app restart the renamed set and the exclusion are intact; snapshot exported.
